name: Positional & Normal-Based Voxel Shadowing
definition: Calculates a per-face shadow multiplier using block position, block type, and face normal to simulate directional shading without ray tracing.
summary: Positional & Normal-Based Voxel Shadowing is a deterministic shading technique that simulates lighting using block coordinates and face orientation, distinct from ray tracing by replacing geometric visibility tests with static arithmetic rules.
